flicker.symptom: Every changed frame (typing and model output) flashed the whole screen in EverTerm; static home screen did not flash continuously.
flicker.root_cause: OpenTUI wrapped every changed frame in DECSET 2026 synchronized-output (ESC[?2026h ... ESC[?2026l). EverTerm 1.5-2 presents each synchronized-output block as a full-screen present, so each update flashed.

user_ab.method: The user ran a patched copy of the same CLI bundle with only synchronizedOutput changed from "always" to "never" (/var/mobile/ocdev/node26/opencode-nosync.sh) inside EverTerm.
user_ab.result: User reported: "测试 A解决" (flicker gone).
user_ab.conclusion: The DECSET 2026 envelope is the trigger; frame diffing, cursor hide/show and 20 FPS throttling are not the trigger.

flicker.fix: packages/tui/src/util/mobile.ts terminalRendererOptions() now sets synchronizedOutput: "never" for iOS (patch 0018). Native renderer and Node runtime unchanged.
